text:
Midweek: risk-off. VIX 24; only staples (+0.5%) and energy (+1.9%) are up this week, while chips (-4.9%) and tech (-3.3%) lead the decline.
NVDA: no earnings release was found for 17 Nov; the report now looks likely around 25 Nov. Shares are -7% vs entry, roughly half of that the market. Held as a quality dip.
AMD is beating the market this week (+4.8% after removing the market move).
SNOW and CRWD are still held; Monday's trend-broken sells remain the plan.
Monday's buys (VOO, MCK, TMO, MA, KO) are still open as catch-ups; V dropped off. No news argues against them.

cautions.why: Earnings date unconfirmed (likely ~25 Nov); CEO investigation ongoing.
